name: EditorialToggleGroup

props.description: The toggles; label is the text and the accessible name.
props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]

props.description: Labels, or framed icon-only buttons. Default: "text".
props.name: variant

related: Segmented — a track with a lifted slab.
tagline: One-of-N toggles of the editorial account family (gh#1439): a named `role="group"` of `aria-pressed` buttons. `variant="text"` is a filter row (pressed = filled, bordered); `variant="icon"` a framed icon-only switch such as grid / list view, each button named by its label. Geometry: `--editorial-toggle-group-*`.
usage: DO use it above a collection to filter it or switch its view; the collection is yours.
DO pass a lucide icon per item for the icon variant — the label stays the button's name.
